about-us.title: About Us | SOS Foundation
about-us.description: Learn about SOS Foundation, the CSR arm of SOS Group of Companies, and our vision, mission and values for a more equitable Pakistan.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: Audience at an SOS Foundation event.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: SOS Foundation is the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) arm of SOS Group of Companies. It was established in 2017 under SOS Pakistan (Pvt.) Ltd. as a not-for-profit organisation. We work to improve the lives of underserved and marginalised communities across Pakistan through sustainable, community-driven development.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We are backed by the long-term commitment of SOS Group and our Board of Trustees. This brings corporate discipline, accountability and continuity to our social development work. We work alongside communities, government departments, civil society organisations and international development partners, so that our efforts complement national and provincial priorities.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Education and workforce development have been at the heart of our work since 2017. Through scholarships, teacher training and support for higher education, we have helped young people from low-income households continue their studies and build pathways to dignified employment. Our flagship initiative, the National University for Security Sciences (NUSS), Islamabad, has had its charter approved by both the National Assembly and the Senate of Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Alongside education, we have responded to urgent basic needs. We have installed reverse osmosis (RO) water filtration plants and hand pumps that bring safe drinking water to underserved communities, and we run hunger-relief initiatives that provide meals and rations to vulnerable families. Today our work spans nine thematic programmes, from health and climate action to women's empowerment and human rights.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: A world where every person can live with dignity, opportunity and hope, free from poverty and hardship.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: To empower underserved communities through sustainable, partnership-driven initiatives in education, healthcare, clean water and livelihoods, so that they can move from hardship to self-reliance.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We put people first, serving every community with empathy, respect and care for human dignity.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We act with honesty, transparency and fairness, and we honour the trust our partners and communities place in us.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We take responsibility for our decisions, our use of resources and our results, and we report openly to communities, donors and partners.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We reach those most often left behind, including women, children, persons with disabilities and remote communities, without discrimination of any kind.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We believe lasting change comes from working together with communities, government, the private sector and development partners.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We seek creative, evidence-based solutions that deliver lasting impact and can grow to reach more people.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We design programmes that communities can own and carry forward, so that impact lasts beyond our direct involvement.

fields.label: Quote
fields.md: “Business success carries a responsibility to the society that makes it possible.”

about-us/ceo-message.title: CEO's Message | SOS Foundation
about-us/ceo-message.description: SOS Foundation empowers underserved communities across Pakistan through education, health, clean water, climate action and livelihoods.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: Dr. Abdus Salam

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Pakistan's development challenges are well documented, and they demand serious, sustained and collective action. More than 25 million children aged 5 to 16 are out of school, over one-third of that age group¹. Only around 45% of the population uses safely managed drinking water². Female labour force participation stands at just 24.4%³, and the 2022 floods affected 33 million people⁴, a stark reminder of how climate change compounds poverty. Yet with 64% of our population under the age of 30⁵, Pakistan also holds one of the greatest demographic opportunities in the world, if we invest in our people today.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: SOS Foundation exists to help turn that opportunity into reality. Our work is guided by the Constitution of Pakistan, including every child's right to free and compulsory education under Article 25-A, and by the United Nations 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. Every programme we design is aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals and with national development priorities, so that our efforts complement those of government and the wider development sector.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We believe development works best when it is led by communities, not delivered to them. We listen first, design solutions together and build local ownership, so that change continues long after our direct involvement ends. Our approach combines grassroots engagement with evidence-based planning, systematic monitoring and transparent reporting, so that every resource entrusted to us delivers verifiable results. Our partnerships with government institutions, universities, civil society, the private sector and development partners allow us to reach further, learn faster and scale what works.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: As Chief Executive Officer, I am committed to leading SOS Foundation with integrity, professionalism and accountability. We will continue to strengthen our programmes, governance and systems in line with recognised standards of good practice in the non-profit sector. We will measure our success not by the activities we carry out but by the lives we help transform, and we will remain open and answerable to the communities, partners and donors who place their trust in us.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: I am grateful to our Chairman and Board of Trustees for their vision and guidance, to our dedicated team for their commitment, and to every partner, donor and volunteer who stands with us. I warmly invite you to join us in building a better tomorrow, together.

about-us/chairman-message.title: Chairman's Message | SOS Foundation
about-us/chairman-message.description: SOS Foundation empowers underserved communities across Pakistan through education, health, clean water, climate action and livelihoods.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: Kanwar M. Tariq

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We live in a time of profound global challenges. With 2030 fast approaching, the world remains off track on most of the Sustainable Development Goals. Climate change is intensifying floods, heatwaves and droughts across the globe. Inequality is widening, conflicts and economic shocks are pushing millions back into poverty, and the poorest communities have the fewest means to cope.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Pakistan stands at the centre of many of these challenges. We contribute little to global emissions, yet we are among the nations most exposed to climate disasters, as the devastating floods of 2022 made clear. Millions of our children remain out of school, too many families lack safe drinking water and basic healthcare, and many women and young people are still denied the skills and opportunities they need to reach their full potential. At the same time, our young population is our greatest strength. With the right investment, it can become the driving force of a more prosperous and resilient Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: SOS Group of Companies established SOS Foundation in 2017 on a clear conviction: business success carries a responsibility to the society that makes it possible. For us, corporate social responsibility is not charity alone. It is a long-term investment in people, so that they can live with dignity, opportunity and self-reliance. The Foundation brings the discipline, accountability and continuity of the corporate sector to social development, working with government, academia, civil society and the private sector, because no single organisation can meet these challenges alone.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: On behalf of the Board of Trustees, I affirm that SOS Foundation will always place the most vulnerable people and communities at the centre of its work. We will uphold the highest standards of integrity, transparency and accountability in the use of every resource entrusted to us, and we will measure our success by the lasting change we help create, not by short-term relief alone. In everything we do, we will contribute to Pakistan's national development priorities and to the global 2030 Agenda, and we will build partnerships that turn shared responsibility into shared progress.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: I thank our partners, donors, volunteers and dedicated team, and above all the communities who place their trust in us. I invite you to join us in building a more equitable, resilient and prosperous future for Pakistan and beyond.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Chairman, Board of Trustees, SOS Foundation

fields.md: 1**Expand access** to quality education, healthcare and safe drinking water for underserved communities, and reach more individuals and families directly across all programmes.

fields.label: List item
fields.md: 2**Build self-reliance** through skills development, livelihoods and economic empowerment, with a special focus on women and youth.

fields.label: List item
fields.md: 3**Strengthen resilience** of vulnerable communities against disasters, climate change and economic shocks.

fields.label: List item
fields.md: 4**Deliver measurable impact** through evidence-based programming, monitoring and transparent reporting.

fields.label: List item
fields.md: 5**Grow partnerships** with government, corporate, academic and international partners to diversify our funding base and scale proven solutions.

fields.label: List item
fields.md: 6**Pilot innovation** by testing new interventions that respond to emerging community needs.

fields.label: Paragraph

fields.label: Paragraph

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We track outcomes, not just activities, and report transparently to our stakeholders.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Our governance, financial management and reporting reflect the standards of a responsible corporate group.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Every individual we serve is treated as a partner, not a recipient of charity.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Our interventions are designed to protect communities and never create new risks.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We serve people solely on the basis of need, regardless of religion, ethnicity, gender or political affiliation.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We are committed to protecting children, women and vulnerable adults in all our programmes.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We use every rupee responsibly and are open about how resources are spent.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We stand with communities in their journey from hardship to hope, working with compassion, acting with integrity, and building a more equitable, resilient and prosperous Pakistan, one community at a time.

programmes/climate-change.title: Climate Change and Community Engagement | SOS Foundation
programmes/climate-change.description: Tree plantation, urban greening, climate awareness and youth action to build climate-resilient communities across Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Climate action that starts in our communities.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Climate Change and Community Engagement.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Pakistan contributes less than 1% of global greenhouse gas emissions, yet Germanwatch's Climate Risk Index 2025 ranked it the country most affected by extreme weather in 2022. Melting glaciers, record heatwaves, drought, water scarcity, urban smog and deforestation increasingly threaten health, food security and livelihoods, with the poorest communities hit hardest. SOS Foundation believes climate action must begin at the community level, with youth, women and local communities as agents of change.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 13 (Climate Action); also SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities), SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) and SDG 15 (Life on Land).

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: Women carry young fruit-tree saplings at a plantation drive.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Every year, in collaboration with government departments, educational institutions, community organisations and corporate partners, we plant and distribute fruit-bearing and indigenous trees in homes, schools, universities, parks and public spaces. Families and volunteers take responsibility for caring for the plants, ensuring higher survival rates and lasting community ownership.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We develop and restore green spaces and support urban beautification to reduce urban heat and pollution and restore natural habitats.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: With universities, colleges and schools, we hold regular sessions on climate change, clean energy, smog, biodiversity, conservation, plastic pollution and desertification, turning awareness into practical action.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We mark international environmental days with awareness walks and public campaigns that carry the message of climate action into streets and neighbourhoods.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We mobilise students, interns and community volunteers through plantation drives, clean-ups, environmental competitions and campus green clubs, nurturing a generation of climate leaders.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Working with government institutions, we raise awareness of extreme weather, early warning systems and household preparedness to protect lives, livestock and livelihoods.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We promote responsible consumption, food waste reduction, recycling and composting at household and community level.

fields.label: Section heading
fields.md: Support Climate Change and Community Engagement

programmes/community-development.title: Community Development | SOS Foundation
programmes/community-development.description: Community-led infrastructure, kitchen gardening, volunteering and small business support for self-reliant communities in Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Communities that own their own development.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Community Development.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Strong, self-reliant communities are the foundation of inclusive development. Yet many underserved communities in Pakistan, rural and urban, still lack basic infrastructure, essential services, food security and livelihood opportunities. SOS Foundation works hand in hand with these communities, identifying needs together and delivering practical solutions that foster lasting community ownership.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities); also SDG 1 (No Poverty), SDG 2 (Zero Hunger), SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities) and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We support small-scale infrastructure that responds directly to community needs, such as water hand pumps, drainage and improved access, reducing daily hardships, particularly for women and children.

fields.label: Heading
fields.md: Household Food Security and Kitchen Gardening

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We encourage families to grow their own vegetables, providing plants and gardening tools to improve nutrition, reduce household expenses and earn small additional income from surplus produce.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We involve residents in identifying priorities, planning interventions and maintaining shared resources, so every initiative is owned and sustained by the community itself.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through volunteer drives and giving campaigns, we mobilise students and citizens to share books, stationery and other essentials with children and families in need. We also encourage community members to turn small skills, such as tailoring, home-based food preparation and handicrafts, into small business opportunities, helping families earn a dignified livelihood rather than depend on aid.

programmes/education-for-all.title: Education for All | SOS Foundation
programmes/education-for-all.description: Scholarships, teacher training, literacy and girls' education to help Pakistan's 25 million out-of-school children learn and thrive.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Every child in school. Every learner a future.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Education for All.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Education is a fundamental right and a cornerstone of social and economic development. Yet over 25 million children aged 5 to 16, about 35% of that age group, are out of school in Pakistan. National literacy stands at 60.7%, and only 52.8% for women, while 77% of ten-year-olds cannot read and understand a simple text. SOS Foundation works to close these gaps through inclusive, equitable and quality education and lifelong learning for children, youth and adults, upholding every child's constitutional right to education under Article 25-A.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Source: Pakistan Institute of Education, Pakistan Education Statistics 2023-24 and Public Financing in Education 2025-26; Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, Census 2023.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 4 (Quality Education); also SDG 1 (No Poverty), SDG 5 (Gender Equality) and SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation and NUSS representatives at an event in Islamabad.

fields.label: Heading
fields.md: Flagship Initiative: National University for Security Sciences (NUSS)

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Our flagship higher education project is the National University for Security Sciences, Islamabad, whose charter has been approved by both the National Assembly and the Senate of Pakistan. NUSS is envisioned as a centre of excellence for higher education, research and professional development in security sciences and allied disciplines. It will soon begin operations and will develop skilled professionals and future leaders for Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We provide scholarships and financial assistance to talented students facing financial hardship, helping them pursue education at school, college and university level.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We build the capacity of educators through training workshops on modern pedagogy, 21st-century teaching skills and classroom management.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We help out-of-school children return to learning through accelerated learning programmes, learning materials and partnerships with community-based schools.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Our adult literacy programme offers second-chance learning to adults with little or no formal education. Through public awareness walks, policy dialogues and national literacy campaigns, we also advocate for action on Pakistan's literacy and out-of-school challenges.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We advocate for girls' right to education and work to remove the barriers that keep them out of school, including poverty, safety concerns, social norms and early dropout. Through campaigns, seminars and partnerships with academic institutions, we promote girls' education, leadership and careers in science and technology.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We support the establishment and renovation of schools and learning spaces in underserved areas, so that students can learn in safe and conducive environments.

programmes/health-and-nutrition.title: Health and Nutrition | SOS Foundation
programmes/health-and-nutrition.description: Free medical camps, disease prevention, nutrition and hunger relief for vulnerable communities across Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Healthier communities, from prevention to care.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Health and Nutrition.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Pakistan faces a heavy burden of preventable disease and malnutrition. Around 40% of children under five are stunted, and Pakistan has the highest number of hepatitis C infections in the world, an estimated 8.8 million. Limited access to healthcare and low health awareness hit vulnerable communities hardest. SOS Foundation works to improve community health through medical outreach, preventive care, nutrition and support for families in need.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Source: National Nutrition Survey 2018 (Government of Pakistan, Aga Khan University and UNICEF); World Health Organization, Global Hepatitis Report 2024.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger); also SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) and SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We organise free medical camps in underprivileged areas, offering general consultations, basic diagnostic screening, free medicines and health education, with referrals for further treatment where needed.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: With medical universities, hospitals and academic institutions, we run awareness sessions on the prevention, early detection and treatment of communicable diseases such as hepatitis and tuberculosis, and we promote stigma-free support for patients.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We promote balanced nutrition and safe food practices, including hygiene, safe food preparation and handling, to prevent food- and water-borne diseases.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through our hunger-relief initiatives, we provide nutritious meals and food support to vulnerable families, helping them meet their basic needs with dignity.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We raise awareness among youth and communities about the harms of drug abuse and promote prevention, rehabilitation and recovery through community action.

fields.md: Healthcare at the Doorstep in Bari Imam

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.section: Healthcare at the Doorstep in Bari Imam

programmes/human-rights.title: Human Rights | SOS Foundation
programmes/human-rights.description: Rights awareness, interfaith harmony, freedom of expression and public advocacy for dignity and equality for all in Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Dignity, equality and respect for all.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Human Rights.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Human rights are the foundation of a just, peaceful and inclusive society. Yet many people in Pakistan, particularly in marginalised communities, remain unaware of their fundamental rights and face barriers to equality and full participation. SOS Foundation promotes awareness of the rights guaranteed under the Constitution of Pakistan and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and fosters a culture of dignity, equality, tolerance and mutual respect.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 16 (Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions); also SDG 4 (Quality Education), SDG 5 (Gender Equality) and SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through sessions and workshops in educational institutions and communities, we educate young people about their fundamental rights and encourage them to uphold the rights of others.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We promote human fraternity, interfaith harmony and peaceful coexistence, building respect for every individual regardless of faith, ethnicity or social status.

fields.label: Heading
fields.md: Freedom of Expression and Responsible Digital Citizenship

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We promote freedom of expression, access to accurate information and the responsible use of social media and emerging technologies, and we raise awareness among youth about misinformation.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through public awareness walks and campaigns, we bring citizens together to call for equality, justice and dignity for all.

programmes/humanitarian-response.title: Humanitarian Response | SOS Foundation
programmes/humanitarian-response.description: Emergency and winter relief, disaster preparedness and youth volunteering for families affected by floods and disasters in Pakistan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Standing with communities when crisis strikes.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Humanitarian Response.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Pakistan is highly exposed to floods, extreme weather and other climate-induced disasters. The 2022 floods alone affected 33 million people, claimed more than 1,730 lives and caused over USD 30 billion in damages and economic losses. SOS Foundation stands with affected communities in times of crisis, providing timely relief while building preparedness for long-term recovery.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Source: Government of Pakistan, World Bank, ADB, EU and UNDP, Post-Disaster Needs Assessment: Floods 2022.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 1 (No Poverty), SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities) and SDG 13 (Climate Action); also SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: With universities and established welfare organisations, we mobilise and deliver food rations, clothing, bedding and other household essentials to disaster-affected families.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We support displaced and flood-affected families with quilts, warm clothing and other essentials to help them through harsh winters.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We build awareness of disaster risk reduction, early warning systems and household preparedness, with a special focus on training young people.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through seminars and campus engagement, we promote humanitarian values and encourage young people to volunteer in support of vulnerable communities.

programmes/livelihoods.title: Livelihoods | SOS Foundation
programmes/livelihoods.description: Digital and vocational skills, employability and entrepreneurship helping Pakistan's youth and women move from skills to income.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Livelihoods.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Pakistan is one of the youngest countries in the world: 64% of its population is under 30. Yet national unemployment has risen to 7.1%, its highest level in over two decades, and many young people, women and members of underserved communities lack market-relevant skills and decent work. SOS Foundation works to unlock this potential through skills development, employability and entrepreneurship, helping people move from dependence to dignity and self-reliance.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Source: UNDP, Pakistan National Human Development Report: Unleashing the Potential of a Young Pakistan; Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, Labour Force Survey 2024-25.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth); also SDG 1 (No Poverty), SDG 5 (Gender Equality) and SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We promote digital and IT skills as pathways to employment, freelancing and online entrepreneurship, with a focus on youth and women.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We support training in market-relevant trades for youth outside formal education and for women from underserved communities, and encourage recognised skills certification.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through seminars, career sessions and campus engagement, we help young people build soft skills, career readiness and confidence for the job market.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We encourage individuals and families to start small businesses and home-based enterprises, turning skills into sustainable household income.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We convene universities, skills institutions, government bodies and the private sector to strengthen collaboration on youth skills, adult literacy and pathways to employment.

programmes/wash.title: Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) | SOS Foundation
programmes/wash.description: RO water plants, hand pumps, sanitation and hygiene promotion bringing safe water and healthier living to underserved communities.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Safe water, sanitation and hygiene for every home.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Safe water, proper sanitation and good hygiene are fundamental to health and dignity. Yet only around 45% of Pakistan's population uses safely managed drinking water, leaving millions exposed to preventable waterborne disease. Women and girls carry much of this burden, often spending long hours fetching water. SOS Foundation works to close these gaps through practical interventions, hygiene promotion and community participation.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme, SDG indicator 6.1.1 (2024), via the UN-Water SDG 6 Data Portal.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation); also SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being), SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities) and SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We install reverse osmosis (RO) water filtration plants and water hand pumps in underserved communities, bringing safe drinking water closer to people's homes. Water quality is tested by recognised laboratories, including the National Institute of Health, to confirm it is fit for human consumption.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We support small-scale sanitation and drainage improvements based on community needs, creating cleaner and safer living environments.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through our ongoing Hygiene Promotion Drive, we run interactive sessions in schools and communities on handwashing, personal and oral hygiene and household cleanliness, and provide hygiene supplies to help these habits stick.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We promote waste segregation, recycling, composting of organic waste and avoiding waste burning, helping communities keep their surroundings clean and healthy.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: "My children are not falling sick like before. Clean water has given us peace of mind." (Nasreen, Mumtazabad)

programmes/women-empowerment.title: Women Empowerment | SOS Foundation
programmes/women-empowerment.description: Vocational skills, livelihood support, education and advocacy that help women in Pakistan build confidence and economic independence.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Skilled, confident and economically independent women.

fields.label: Photo
fields.alt: SOS Foundation activity: Women Empowerment.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Women make up nearly half of Pakistan's population, yet remain among the most underrepresented groups in economic and public life. In the World Economic Forum's Global Gender Gap Report 2026, Pakistan ranked 143rd of 145 economies and last in South Asia, with economic participation its weakest area at 144th. Female labour force participation stands at 24.4%, compared with 69.8% for men, and female unemployment at 10.5%, against 6.0% for men. SOS Foundation believes that empowering women is one of the most effective ways to lift families out of poverty.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Source: World Economic Forum, Global Gender Gap Report 2026; Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, Labour Force Survey 2024-25.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: **SDG alignment:** primarily SDG 5 (Gender Equality); also SDG 4 (Quality Education), SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth) and SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We run stitching, embroidery and other vocational classes for women and girls in underserved communities, providing sewing machines, materials and structured instruction.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We provide women with tools such as sewing machines and kitchen gardening kits to turn their skills into home-based income.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We help women in rural and peri-urban communities explore practical livelihoods, including stitching, cooking, vegetable gardening and compost-making.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: We promote women's access to education, higher learning and leadership, and encourage young women to pursue their academic and professional aspirations.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: Through seminars, conferences and awareness events with universities, government bodies and civil society, we advocate for women's rights, dignity and equal participation in decision-making.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.md: "Earlier, I waited for help with everything. Now I earn for myself." (Farha)
